mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) VALUES (#{blockerId}, #{blockedId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{blockerId} AND blocked_id = #{blockedId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{blockerId} AND blocked_id = #{blockedId}
